# ADAM v0.43 Gap-Closure Architecture

```text
EXACT ATOMIC EVIDENCE
        │
        ├── deterministic modality codecs
        ├── trained semantic organs
        ├── ambiguity / OOD abstention
        └── inference receipts (non-authoritative)
                │
                ▼
GOVERNED SEMANTIC UNIVERSE
        │
        ├── Horn proof engine
        ├── symbolic conservation prover
        ├── bounded counterexample search
        └── reaction / authority validation
                │
                ▼
ISOLATED AUTHORITY
        │
        ├── application process has no private key
        ├── 2-of-3 signing quorum
        ├── PKCS#11 / KMS provider contract
        ├── native protocol conformance binary
        └── Rust production-target kernel source
                │
                ▼
PRODUCTION QUALIFICATION
        ├── real wall-clock controller
        ├── daily signed evidence
        ├── SLA and latency gates
        ├── failover / recovery injection
        └── final certificate only after elapsed duration
```

The result remains faithful to Atom Theory: representations are reconstructed from authoritative atomic conditions, while learned interpretation and temporary application forms remain governed outputs rather than replacement authorities.
